'''John Helton''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 DragonCon Open]] on 1 September 2001 with [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|Hidden Base (X-wing swarm)]], according to Zafar Tejani's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2938">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-06-z-goes-to-dragoncon-2001d2938/ z-goes-to-dragoncon-2001], DeckTech (Zafar "Zmanthe1st" Tejani, 6 September 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-06-z-goes-to-dragoncon-2001d2938/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
